title: I Hired 3 AI Coworkers And They Talk To Each Other
description:
xAI launched Grok Bot in beta on 11 August 2026. Each Bot gets its own computer in the cloud and signs into the same applications a human employee would use, including tools with no API or connector. Jobs continue when you close your laptop and the Bot comes back when it needs approval rather than direction. Bots retain context across conversations, and multiple Bots can run in one group chat, passing work between each other and assigning ownership. Access is bundled into xAI's higher subscription tiers at a reported $120 per month.

Get the free guide with the four Bots to build first here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1mZ3arbMuf7oCsAOkEcB-sQ-_F1HrmKxuF3zEMyUaD2g/edit?usp=sharing
